text: Q: What skills does TCS look for? A: TCS looks for strong aptitude (quantitative, logical and verbal), basic programming knowledge in C, Java or Python, and good communication skills. Awareness of data structures and databases is a plus.

Q: What is the TCS selection process? A: The process has three stages: an online aptitude and coding test, a technical interview, and an HR interview. Candidates must clear each stage to move to the next.

Q: What is the eligibility for TCS? A: Students need a minimum of 7.0 CGPA (or 70 percent) throughout academics and no active backlogs at the time of the drive. Eligible branches are CSE, IT, ECE and EEE.

Q: Which roles does TCS offer to freshers? A: TCS offers entry-level roles in two categories, a standard category for general software roles and a digital category for candidates who perform well in advanced coding rounds.

Q: What skills does Infosys look for? A: Infosys looks for logical reasoning, problem solving, basic coding ability, and a willingness to learn. Knowledge of Python, Java or SQL helps in the technical round.
Q: What is the Infosys selection process? A: Candidates take an online test covering reasoning, mathematical ability, verbal ability and pseudocode, followed by a technical and HR interview.
Q: What is the eligibility for Infosys? A: Students need a minimum of 6.5 CGPA and at most one active backlog. All engineering branches are eligible, along with MCA and MSc Computer Science.

Q: What skills does Wipro look for? A: Wipro looks for aptitude, an essay or written communication test performance, basic programming skills, and teamwork. Communication skills carry significant weight.
Q: What is the eligibility for Wipro? A: Students need a minimum of 60 percent or 6.0 CGPA in 10th, 12th and graduation, with no active backlogs at the time of the drive.

Q: What is the Cognizant selection process? A: The process includes an online assessment on aptitude and coding, followed by a technical interview and an HR interview. Some drives add a communication round.
Q: What is the eligibility for Cognizant? A: Students need a minimum of 6.0 CGPA and at most one active backlog. CSE, IT, ECE and EEE branches are eligible.
Q: What skills does Accenture look for? A: Accenture looks for cognitive and technical assessment performance, problem solving, coding fundamentals, and strong English communication.

Q: What documents should I carry to a placement drive? A: Carry your college ID card, a government photo ID, several printed copies of your resume, passport-size photographs, and mark sheets from 10th grade to the latest semester.

Q: How do I register for a company drive? A: Register through the placement cell portal before the deadline given in the placement notice. Late registrations are not accepted. Only students who meet the eligibility criteria can register.
